$:set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
p='workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/oauth.mjs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("if(url.pathname==='/\\.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'){return false}\n","")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node --check workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/oauth.mjs
f=workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/oauth.mjs
sha=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
gh api -X PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" -f message="Fix OAuth discovery route" -f sha="$sha" -f content="$(base64 -w0 "$f")" --jq .commit.sha
cd workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp
npm install --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null
PORT=39778 MCP_ALLOWED_GITHUB_LOGIN=BestNameYet MCP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://shiny-robot-3000.app.github.dev MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=test-client MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=test-secret node http-server.mjs >/tmp/mcp-test-39778.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
sleep 2
printf 'DISCOVERY: '
curl -sS -o /tmp/discovery39778.json -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:39778/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
cat /tmp/discovery39778.json
printf '\nUNAUTHORIZED: '
curl -sS -o /tmp/denied39778.json -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' http://127.0.0.1:39778/mcp
cat /tmp/denied39778.json
